description: This Java class defines a model for managing boolean inputs, including input titles and value labels for specific channels. It provides methods for setting input values and retrieving labels and titles related to boolean inputs in a UI context.

classes.name: BooleanInputsModel
classes.description: A model class for handling boolean input states and displaying corresponding labels based on channel identifiers.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns a formatted title string for a given channel, incorporating the input's descriptive title if available.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the boolean value for a specific channel.

methods.name: getValueLabelText
methods.description: Returns a label text representing the boolean state for a channel, using predefined strings or the default Boolean.toString() output.
